name: Desk Lamp Mini Kit
description: A beginner DIY desk lamp: base, stem, shade, bulb socket, and cable. No soldering required.
safety: Keep the power cable unplugged until the final safety check.
Do not touch exposed conductors on the cable ends.
Use only the included low-voltage LED bulb.

parts.name: Lamp base
parts.description: Weighted circular base with a threaded center socket for the stem.

parts.name: Stem tube
parts.description: Hollow metal tube with threads on both ends. Cable runs inside.

parts.name: Bulb socket
parts.description: E26/E27 style socket with two screw terminals (L and N) and a top thread for the shade ring.

parts.name: Power cable with inline switch
parts.description: Two-conductor cable with an inline rocker switch and a wall plug. Free end has stripped leads.

parts.name: Lamp shade
parts.description: Fabric shade with a metal spider that sits on the socket and locks with the shade ring.

parts.name: Shade ring
parts.description: Small threaded ring that secures the shade to the socket.

parts.name: LED bulb
parts.description: Included low-voltage LED bulb. Screw-in only — do not force.

parts.name: M4 set screw
parts.description: Short set screw that locks the stem into the base collar.

steps.title: Attach stem to base
steps.instructions: Thread STEM-01 into the center of BASE-01 until snug. Insert SCREW-M4 into the collar hole and tighten gently with the included hex key so the stem cannot rotate.
steps.tip: If the stem wobbles, back it out half a turn, reseat straight, then retighten the set screw.
steps.verify: Stem stands vertical and does not twist by hand.

steps.title: Route cable through stem
steps.instructions: Feed the free stripped end of CABLE-01 up through the base hole and through STEM-01 until about 8 cm of cable exits the top of the stem. Keep the inline switch outside the base, on the long plug side.
steps.tip: Tape the stripped leads together so they do not snag while pulling.
steps.verify: Cable slides freely; switch sits outside the lamp, not trapped under the base.

steps.title: Wire the bulb socket
steps.instructions: Screw SOCK-01 onto the top of STEM-01. Loosen the two terminal screws. Attach one cable lead under L and the other under N. Tighten firmly. Tug lightly to confirm the wires stay seated.
steps.tip: Polarity is not critical for this LED kit, but keep strands neat — no whiskers sticking out.
steps.verify: Both leads are clamped; no bare copper is visible outside the terminals.

steps.title: Mount the shade
steps.instructions: Place SHADE-01 so the spider rests on the socket shoulder. Thread RING-01 onto the socket and tighten until the shade is secure but not crushed.
steps.tip: Hold the shade level while tightening so it does not sit crooked.
steps.verify: Shade is level and does not rattle when you nudge it.

steps.title: Install bulb and safety check
steps.instructions: Screw BULB-01 into the socket. Confirm the wall plug is still unplugged. Check that the inline switch is OFF. Only then plug in and flip the switch ON for a quick test. Unplug again if you need to adjust anything.
steps.tip: If it does not light, unplug first, then recheck terminal screws from step 3.
steps.verify: Lamp lights with switch ON; no buzzing, smoke, or hot spots on the cable.
